title: Qualification version changes invalidate every dependent capability
blocker: The portable component chain now verifies signed qualification/current-catalog evidence and binds it to guarded reads, but no Qman product repository atomically rereads every current pointer, commits the unique admission binding plus lease, and enforces that binding at every query/schedule/attach consumer.
assertions: a capability records the exact publisher snapshot, qualification profile, policy version and verifier identity it consumed
changing any referenced qualification content or signer version invalidates the old capability before scheduling or attach
an unrelated profile change does not invalidate capabilities whose dependency set is disjoint
revoked, unknown or stale signer identities fail closed without a runtime override

the product repository rereads current policy, trust, catalog, inventory and availability authorities and commits one admission binding plus ASSIGNMENT_PREPARE lease in the same serializable transaction or writes neither
a host executor accepts ASSIGNMENT_PREPARE only when the live lease admissionBindingHash matches the persisted unique binding
